name: Office of the Regional Director
purpose: The executive office of DENR-EMB Region VII. Official institutional decisions and approvals are led by the Regional Director.

name: GIS, Digital Development & IT Office
purpose: The technical workspace for GIS, ENVIS development and maintenance, project coordination, web checking, and lead IT responsibilities.
functions: Web checking and lead IT responsibilities

name: MIS, Planning & PISMU Office
purpose: The office space for management information systems, planning, and overall PISMU leadership.

name: ECC & CNC Data Office
purpose: The data-encoding workspace for environmental clearance information, including ECC and CNC records.

name: Air & Water Permitting Section
purpose: The section workspace for air and water permitting information and associated data records.

name: Server & Database Security Room
purpose: The technical room for server operations and database security oversight for EMB systems.

name: AQMS Data & Monitoring Office
purpose: The workspace for Air Quality Monitoring System data management and monitoring records.

name: Central Lobby & Reception
purpose: The shared central lobby connecting the EMB office areas.

name: Hazardous Waste Records Office
purpose: The data management workspace for hazardous waste registrations and records.

name: Solid Waste Management Data Office
purpose: The workspace for Solid Waste Management data encoding and records.

name: Regional Staff Lounge
purpose: A shared staff area for breaks and informal conversations.
